card.name: Superscript digits in units and powers
card.fires_on: Digits written as superscripts or exponents, such as the 2 in m2 or cm2 or the 6 in 10^6. It fires in dosing and lab text where powers of ten or area units appear.

modes.label: Area units
modes.description: The 2 after m or cm in body surface area or wound area.
modes.example: One sheet of ZEVASKYN covers an area of 41.25 cm <<2>> .

modes.label: Powers of ten
modes.description: The exponent digit after 10 in cell counts or vector genome doses.

modes.label: Digits inside formulas
modes.description: A digit or equals sign inside a formula or number in a dosing calculation.
